label: 90′ SKYBRIDGE
authoring: Written by the rig: SportFisherIso2.byId('skybridge').walk(), every number its own (mm), stamped with the rig's LF sha256 and fitted to character rig 10.3 (qa.character) by tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs. Regenerate with node tools/rig-recipes/hull-walk.mjs --write; never edit by hand.
frame: metres; +x starboard, +y bow, +z up; origin amidships, keel bottom, centreline; polygons counter-clockwise seen from above

walk.rule: A step is legal when the target point is inside an area polygon and outside its holes, and |area z − player z| < stepTol. Ramps interpolate z along their axis between a0 and a1, and hold z0 / z1 beyond them. cut is the cutaway key while standing there; cutHi / cutLo replace it above / below zMid. Polygons are player-centre: already inset by the radius, so the reader never insets them again.

_excluded.reason: the foredeck forward of the house, its crown at 3.839 m: no way there outside, since the house sides stand on the sheer behind the 0.09 m rail (0.149–0.54 m reveal), and no hatch from below, so no walk area. The windlass is worked from the helm.

the open top station on the skylounge roof (7.97 m), 1.482 m under the hardtop: reached only by the station ladder from the aft deck (top_station_ladder), so no walk area. Its helm is the helm_top interact.
the hardtop’s roof at 9.55 m carries the radar and the rod launcher: no rail and no way up, so no standing surface.
the engine room aft of the cabins’ bulkhead (y -3), its floor at 0.7 m: the engines fill it and it opens only with the below cut, so no walk area.
the day head, 1 × 1.3 m inside its walls on the salon sole: a seated space entered by its interact, not walked. Its door faces the settees’ aft ends 0.45 m away.
the station ladder at the aft rail, from the aft deck (5.52 m) to the top station (7.97 m), 9 rungs and near upright: its foot is outside the aft deck’s walk, and climbing it waits on ladderOn.
no swim ladder or boarding platform is drawn on this hull, and the transom door is drawn shut: coming aboard from the water waits on ladderOn and a ladder.
the transom door, 1.05 m wide and 0.72 m high, is drawn shut and no state opens it yet, so the transom stays a wall.
the tuna door, 1 m wide and 0.62 m high, is drawn shut and no state opens it yet, so the transom stays a wall.
no washboards: the house sides stand on the sheer behind the 0.09 m rail, 0.149–0.54 m from it, so there is no side deck to climb onto.
